Leah (CSM): FYI Obsidian Labs submitted an intake to run a domain-tuned clinical model in our Private offering. Model is ~34B, QAT/int4-ish artifacts, will handle PHI. They require HSM keywrap, no model exfil, and audit-ready logs. Renewal in 6 weeks so timeline is tight. :alarm_clock:
Matteo (Solutions Eng): Do we have the artifact format & size? any custom ops?
Leah (CSM): Uploaded to their secure bucket earlier — looks like TorchScript + quant metadata. Ticket has link.
Samir (ML Eng): Good to know. Need answers: max seq len, expected peak/tokens, realtime vs batch, p95 target, and allowed quality delta. 34B at 2k tokens is heavy even quantized.
Leah (CSM): Typical sequences ~1800-2200 tokens. Traffic: mostly async dumps overnight + small realtime UI calls during day. p95 required < 400ms for UI. Customer said minor accuracy regression acceptable if documented.
Priya (Security): Must confirm HSM vendor, keywrap flow, and that weights never leave VPC. Also need KMS integration test, retention policy, and who signs audits. Any onprem HSM details yet?
Leah (CSM): They plan to expose an HSM in their VPC (Entrust HSM). Sales looped legal for BAA.
Matteo (Solutions Eng): Infra plan: private control plane with peered VPCs, dedicated GPU pool pinned to tenant, and egress locked down. We'll need firewall rules (allow 9090/443 to control plane, block public internet), HSM certs, and a canary strategy.
Samir (ML Eng): My proposed sequence: 1) offline functional + PHI-leakage eval with synthetic prompts 2) perf profile on dev nodepool (T4x2) 3) optimization pass (KV cache, prefix caching, per-request kv policy) 4) canary at 3% -> 15% -> 50% with automated rollback on latency/error thresholds.
Samir (ML Eng): Example eval I'll run:
```
./run_eval.sh --model /intake/obsidian/34b_qat.pt --promptset tests/clinical_leakage_set.json --seq_len 2000 --metrics ppl,exact_match,phi_leakage_scan --out results/obsidian_eval_v1.json
```
Matteo (Solutions Eng): For perf, I'll spin a small nodepool (4x T4) and run mixed-batch profiling. If results bad, move to A100 pod. Need rough GPU-hour estimate from Samir.
Leah (CSM): I'll ask Obsidian for: daily token estimate, must-pass prompt list, SLA acceptance window for rollout, and their audit contact. Also confirm whether they accept our fallback behavior.
Priya (Security): Security gating: 1) HSM keywrap proof-of-possess 2) KMS integration smoke test 3) token redaction in logs 4) audit trail retention window agreed 5) no model artifact snapshots to our S3. Provide sensitivity matrix.
Leah (CSM): They accept redacted logs but want full traceability in audit logs. I'll add to the ticket.
Samir (ML Eng): NOTE: 2k tokens + 34B on T4 may not hit 400ms p95. Options: aggressive KV cache, sequence trimming, or fallback distilled 8B for UI. Fallback could be served by a low-latency variant with routing policy.
Matteo (Solutions Eng): We can implement routing + automatic fallback in our Private runtime: canary -> fallback to 8B if latency > 600ms or error rate > 2%. Also plan a warm KV cache pre-warming job for nightly batch runs.
Priya (Security): Must add PHI red-team prompts in the safety suite. Expect zero leakage tolerance on synthetic PHI tests. We'll require those eval artifacts before we greenlight canary.
Leah (CSM): Renewal impact: marking account "at-risk" and pushing for a firm timeline. Sarah (renewals) asked for delivery estimate within 3 weeks to avoid churn.
Samir (ML Eng): I'll start offline leakage + perf runs tomorrow and share results. If accuracy drops >3% on core metrics we'll propose quantization tuning or a lightly distilled variant.
Matteo (Solutions Eng): I'll open infra ticket INF-8942 and attach the private cluster blueprint and firewall checklist.
intake-bot: Intake created CS-4789 (Obsidian Labs) 1: assigned Leah, Matteo, Samir. Link: https://redwood.example.com/intake/CS-4789 :white_check_mark:
Leah (CSM): Thanks team. I'll schedule a 30m sync for Tuesday 09:00 UTC (tentative) with Obsidian. Who can join? :calendar:
Samir (ML Eng): I'll be there for eval review.
Matteo (Solutions Eng): I'll join for infra & networking.
Priya (Security): I'll join for PHI signoff.
Leah (CSM): Action items recap: Samir -> run eval + perf and post results; Matteo -> infra ticket + nodepool; Leah -> collect must-pass prompts, token estimates, HSM cert date, and update renewal status. Will post ETA after eval. :pushpin:
